Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle moved into their lane during a lane
change. Complaints centered on the right knee, with pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion reported from the outset. The
mechanism described is consistent with the knee injury being evaluated, and the patient has no known prior injury to this body
region. Examination revealed some findings that support a meniscal or ligamentous problem, while other orthopedic and
neurovascular tests returned within normal limits. Care was delivered over 25 visits, which ran somewhat longer than typical for
this type of injury, consisting of physical therapy, activity modification, and home exercise instruction. Billed services reflect
single, appropriate charges for each encounter with no duplicate entries. Based on current status, the patient is improving
gradually, and further evaluation will be considered if symptoms persist.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
